title: EXPLORATORY: f45r copies the immutable A-prefix available at the written anchor, not the completed paragraph
summary: A complete unknown-meaning counterpart to IDEA1104 on the same86ITgroups. At each eligible ordinary written anchor, retain the expanded A-list so far, including that anchor. The same two later joined copy events reuse that immutable prefix; other fields and prior-record choices stay unchanged. This is an authored scope contrast, not a new word meaning or confirmed reading.

decision_note.strongest_prior: IDEA1104 already copies completed expanded A-lists27/44/62. R1/Q1/Q2 and1104are inconclusive; staticcopy plus separately assumed qcomplements conflicts. New anchoring or a nicer outcome cannot erase these decisions.
decision_note.actual_question: If the reference names the description as it stood when its ordinary anchor was written, what exact different content reaches the next two complete paragraphs?
decision_note.outcome_changes: An inconsistent or nonunique trace stops this authored variant. A complete deterministic expansion retains a genuinely different whole-page candidate with its exact content differences; it does not select it over completed-paragraphcopy, fresh description or another scope. No independently confirmed semantic discriminator is required to begin this exploratory authoring.
decision_note.smallest_work: A small derivation over the unchanged admitted R1trace, manual independent list comparison and a German whole-page account. No new manuscript query, image, source corpus, decoder or control benchmark.
decision_note.inclusive_budget: 2026-10-17T13:22:34Z–14:07:34Z, including broad route/source scouting, primary review, authoring, independent checks, continuity and publication. All source was previously exposed; this is not a blind preregistered prediction.

design.human_rule: When naming an entry during writing, remember its description so far. A later reference repeats that remembered part; descriptions added after the naming point are outside that reference.
design.A: Keep1104's ordered list of unknown description occurrences, not a complete property set of a physical object. Repetition and order are retained as content of the proposed list.
design.ordinary_anchor_snapshot: Immediately after appending each source-explicit ordinary description, store an immutable copy of current expanded A at that written occurrence. This includes the anchor itself and any previously inserted payload. Inherited entries create no new written naming anchors. Snapshots are not subsequently extended by later A-items or B-fields.
design.two_copy_events: Keep exactly1104's finite opchaldy/daldy events, unchanged source IDs, insertion positions and unique earlier completed-record choices. In each selected record require exactly one source-explicit ordinary occurrence matching OPCHAL/DAL. Copy its stored snapshot, preserving order, multiplicity and provenance. Do not choose a cut by resulting compatibility.
design.free_DY: Keep1104's separate kol dy event as one local KOL A-entry, with both original groups retained. This remains an unconfirmed finite role distinction, not a universal DY meaning.
design.other_fields: Retain all1104non-DY Bfields and their original descriptor constraints/record references. They are not copied, and no new subject identity is added. In particular finalDALDAIIN continues the old prior-record choice; it is not changed toQ2latestmention.
design.whole_scope: All86ITsourcegroups, three original paragraphs33/21/32and all original event boundaries. Alternate readers remain qualified evidence of one manuscript, not pooled confirmation. No global morphology or all-XDY claim.
design.manual_precomputed_expectation: P1's written OPCHALis the7thordinary A-item. With the same new rule in both generations, P2's written DALsnapshot has18items; expanded paragraph A-lengths should be27/24/36. These are disclosed manual consequences, not fitted success thresholds or unseen observations.
design.profile_and_counter_account: Use the existingF45_COPY_PROFILES_20261017.json and exactR1/1104claim-bearing priors. No English or German whole-word meaning is proposed. Known DALDYcaption/splitting differences, OPCHALDYrarity, DAIINparagraph-initial counterexamples and unresolved short forms remain. Standalone words are not pooled with embedded strings. No historical gloss is reused.
assumptions: All1104A/Bevent typing, paragraph records and the finite three changedDYevents remain imposed.
An ordinary descriptor can name a prior record, although generic description need not establish identity in real text.
The new commitment is the immutable anchor-time A-prefix, rather than a finalized paragraph body.
The exact same snapshot rule applies recursively; no later or earlier cut, hidden replacement, new time or participant is introduced.
Unknown roots remain unknown; the source words below the trace are bookkeeping labels, not decrypted meanings.
design.known_signed_counter: Do not use absence of the oldqclash as evidence for the new rule. The anchor-time cut was authored with that counter already visible. Report whether it changes the assumed conjunction, while preserving the original completed-copy failure. No qmeaning is selected.
design.source_inverse_ceiling: An expanded A-list alone need not reveal the original written text; retain all86original groups and the tagged derivation. No unique full-language inverse is claimed.
design.phase_correction: The liveguide permits whole exploratory candidates without independently confirmed semantic binding. That permission does not turn stipulated COPY or prefix scope into a manuscript finding, waive profiles, or reopen a failed fixed test.
